Home / Languages / Suh Ankripton

Suh Ankripton

Created by David J. Peterson · Superman (2025 film)

Grammar Overview

  • SVO word order, head-initial — Subject-Verb-Object. Head-initial means objects land clause-final — end-rhyme falls on object case markers (-az). Adjectives follow the nouns they modify.
  • Present tense prefix yo- — yo- is the confirmed present-tense marker. yorel = yo-rel = present-remain. yostan = yo-stan = standing. All present-tense verbs begin yo-.
  • Past tense prefix yov- — yov- marks past tense. yovrhaz = told (past). yovworel = saw (past). The past-negative may infix negation: yovigahum = I didn't see.
  • Object circumfix i-...-az — Definite/specific objects take the circumfix: i- + root + -az. ikilaz = the body (obj). iondaz = the hand (obj). idromaz = the stone (obj).
  • Possessive prefixes — fe- = our (1pl): ferosh = our home. ne- = my (1sg, derived): ne-meq = my meaning. ke- = that/the (demonstrative): ke-rado = these words.
  • Plural suffix -o — kalo = children, woluo = hours, kalo = children. Applies to count nouns.
  • Ablative prefix an- — an- = from. an-Kripton = from Krypton.
  • Max CVC syllable structure — Each syllable has at most one onset consonant and one coda consonant. Clean, crisp phonology — open vowels suit sustained vocal lines.

[N] Past form yovrhaz (past: a walker told us). The rh- onset is unusual — may be yov- + haz with consonant boundary. FLAG: consider whether root is rhaz or haz.

In: banchova-hatu

ankal

one; a person; the one

[N] Canon has "ankal naks" = the last son. Here used as standalone nominal meaning "the one / a person." Uncertain relationship to canon kal (child/son). FLAG.

In: banchova-hatu

bahnek

kneel; bow before (verb root)

[N] Distinct from bah (hear). yovbahnek-el = we knelt-before (past + 1pl -el suffix).

In: banchova-hatu

stan

stand (verb root)

[N] Present form yostan. "Il yostan yu daron-kelor" = I stand in the great dust.

In: banchova-hatu

duron

pedestal; base; foundation

[N] Appears as kosh-iduronaz = the broken pedestal (obj). Parsed as i- + kosh-duron + -az.

In: banchova-hatu

sath

truly (adverb)

[N] Post-verbal adverb. "Jever yovworel pravor sath" = the maker truly saw the face.

In: banchova-hatu

nil

negator (past negative copula element)

[N] Functions in yov-nil = was not / did not. The canon shows negation interleaved in prefixes (yovigahum). yov-nil is an [N] alternative negative-past construction. FLAG: documented as tentative.

In: banchova-hatu
